messages.subject: Shayma | Saudi Mining & Energy Executive Profile | Government Relations, ESG & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Ibrahim,

I am sharing my profile for senior leadership mandates in Saudi Arabia across mining, natural resources, energy transition, industrials and government-facing corporate functions.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio covers senior government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My current exposure also includes a large renewable-energy platform supporting mining operations, with approximately 46-50 MWp of solar and more than 80 MWh of battery storage.

Your Saudi leadership role and executive-search work across Natural Resources & Energy, Industrial and Government make my background closely aligned with the mandates I am pursuing. I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director and VP-track roles across External Affairs, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Social Performance and Country Leadership.

Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority. I have attached a Saudi-focused executive CV for confidential consideration and am available on 30 days' notice.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
